description: Add or replace tags on an existing Finch Vault entry without modifying its content. Useful for organizing entries retroactively. Set replace=true to overwrite all existing tags.

key.description: Entry key to update tags on

replace.description: If true, replaces all existing tags. If false (default), merges with existing.

tags.description: Tags to add (or replace if replace=true)

name: vault_tag
